transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’m exhausted all the time, like I’m running on empty no matter how much I rest. I just don’t have the energy to keep up with anything anymore, and it’s making it hard to do much of anything.
How long have you been feeling this level of exhaustion, and has this been a constant state for at least the past two years?

It hasn't been a full two years, but it has been a constant, heavy burden for about a year and a half now, starting right after they announced the restructuring at my work. Every single day I wake up feeling like I've already worked a double shift, and I just can't get any relief from it.
Besides this persistent exhaustion, have you experienced other symptoms like feeling down, losing interest in things you usually enjoy, or changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?

Yes, I've been feeling deeply down and empty for over a year now, and I've completely lost interest in my fishing and woodworking. My appetite has also dropped off so much that my pants are loose, and no matter how early I go to bed, I still wake up completely exhausted.
Have you experienced any previous periods in your life, lasting at least two weeks, where you felt this same deep sadness and loss of interest, or is this the first time you have ever felt this way?

No, this is the very first time I've ever felt like this in my life. I have never experienced anything like this deep sadness or emptiness before. It all only started about a year and a half ago, right after they announced the restructuring at my work.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or have you felt like you would be better off dead during this period?

To be honest, yes, I've had those thoughts. Some nights I lie in bed thinking it wouldn't be so bad if I just didn't wake up, and I've even pictured driving off the highway or taking all my blood pressure pills. I haven't actually made a plan or set anything up to do it, though.

Given how significantly these symptoms are affecting your daily life, are you still able to function at work or perform basic self-care tasks, or has your condition made it nearly impossible to carry out these activities?

It has become nearly impossible to keep up, and I've started missing shifts and leaving tasks unfinished, which got me a warning from my supervisor. My personal grooming and house cleaning have really slipped too, and I've stopped going to my clubs and church altogether.
During this time, have you ever felt like you were seeing, hearing, or believing things that others around you said were not actually real?

It's hard to talk about, but when I'm alone at night, I often hear this low male voice whispering my name and calling me a failure. I'm also convinced that the management at my job is secretly tracking everything I do, even at home, to find a way to push me out, even though I know others might not believe it.
